_comment: #2326 — hardness SSOT for arbiter's OWN materialized .claude/hooks/. Sibling of .arbiter/hooks-manifest.json, which covers src/templates/claude/hooks (the TEMPLATE surface). Consumed by `scripts/check-hardness-inventory.mjs --manifest .arbiter/self-hooks-manifest.json --hooks-dir .claude/hooks`, wired into the gate as 'hardness inventory (self hooks)'. selfSurface:true makes the checker spawn each hook IN PLACE with cwd at the repo root and the fixture inside the repo — the only arrangement under which arbiter's repo-root-scoped, own-lib-importing hooks actually execute. spawnable:true means OBSERVED (spawned against a violation fixture and asserted to exit 2); spawnable:false means DECLARED ONLY, and every one carries the reason it cannot be driven by a file/env fixture. 10 of 30 are observed today; that ceiling is documented in docs/internal/SYSTEM/HOOK-CONTRACTS.md.

hooks.rationale: INV-04: blocks `any` in TypeScript. Was exit 1 (non-blocking) until #2326 — the violation never reached the agent.
INV-12: blocks direct child_process outside src/utils/run-cli.ts (ADR-020). Fixture must sit under src/ — the hook returns early otherwise. Was exit 1 until #2326.

Blocks unparameterized generics in Java. Unregistered in arbiter's settings.json (no Java sources here) but dogfooded, and its generator already emits exit 2 — the self copy had drifted to exit 1 until #2326.
INV-29: blocks MockMvc in Java tests. Unregistered here (no Java sources) but dogfooded; generator emits exit 2, self copy had drifted to exit 1 until #2326.
INV-21: a TODO without a task ID is a gate violation. Only observable in place — it imports ../../scripts/check-no-orphan-todo.mjs, unresolvable from a staged tmpdir.
INV-12: blocks PII patterns. Only observable in place — imports ../../scripts/lib/suppressions-shared.mjs.
Blocks placeholder/WIP markers before save.
NI-11: skipped/disabled tests must not be committed.

Guards LICENSE / lockfiles. path-only: the fixture names a real protected file and MUST NOT be written. Absolute resolution matters — a relative path fails the hook's repo-root prefix guard and yields a false green. Arbiter deliberately drops AGENTS.md from its read-only set (it authors its own), so the consumer fixture does not apply here.

Guards SSOT paths (DEFAULT_SSOT_PATTERNS plus arbiter.json governance.ssotGuardPatterns). NOT spawnable in place: driving it past the pattern match reaches the one-shot bypass block, which rmSync()s the developer's armed .arbiter/ssot-bypass token — a read-only gate check must never consume user state — and with a non-empty reason the hook then exits 0, reddening the gate on a healthy hook. Observing it needs an isolated repo root (tracked follow-up #2342). Its self lib.mjs remains covered: a broken export there reddens 10 other spawnable hooks, measured.
Blocks dangerous Bash commands and writes to protected Arbiter state.

Blocks `gh pr create` without a valid gate-pass marker. NOT spawnable in place: its verdict depends on live .arbiter/gate-pass.json, which check-all.mjs itself writes at the end of every green run (240 min TTL, and computeTreeHash excludes .arbiter/). A second consecutive L2 on a clean tree would see a valid marker, the hook would correctly exit 0, and the probe would report a ceremony regression — a gate that goes red because the previous gate went green. Needs an isolated root (tracked follow-up #2342).

CANON-16 plan anchor. Not fixture-drivable: requires an active task phase plus a coherent task branch in .claude/.task/status.json, which a file/env fixture cannot supply without mutating live task state.
Governs completion language only while an implementation phase is active — needs live task state, not a file fixture.

#1872 evidence harness. Needs task phase `verification` AND features.evidenceHarness=true in arbiter.json (false in self config), so it is inert by design here; driving it would mean mutating arbiter.json mid-gate.
INV-114. Stop-event hook: needs a transcript file and an active task, supplied via stdin JSON rather than a tool-input path.
A11 CLOSER rules. Applicable only in the `close` phase — needs live task state.
Terminal-state guard. Requires the .arbiter/brainstorm-active marker; planting it in the live repo mid-gate would block the operator's own /task.

PostToolUse conventional-commit check (INV-22) + track-aware checklist (#724) — declared non-blocking in ADR-032. NOTE (#2326): manifest ADVISORY / template exit(2) / self exit(1) are mutually inconsistent. Deliberately NOT reconciled here — adjudicating it needs ADR-032, not a unilateral flip. Tracked as a follow-up.

Blocks on violation (process.exit(2)) — declared HARD, not ADVISORY: .claude/CLAUDE.md claims it blocks and it does. NOT spawnable: the per-edit madge run soft-skips when the tool is unavailable or debounced, so a fixture cannot deterministically reach the blocking branch; the L1 gate is the authoritative check for this rule. (#2326: it was mis-declared ADVISORY in this manifest's first version, which is why the ADVISORY floor check now exists.)

Blocks on violation (process.exit(2)) — declared HARD, not ADVISORY: .claude/CLAUDE.md claims it blocks and it does. NOT spawnable: the per-edit knip run soft-skips when the tool is unavailable or debounced, so a fixture cannot deterministically reach the blocking branch; the L1 gate is the authoritative check for this rule. (#2326: it was mis-declared ADVISORY in this manifest's first version, which is why the ADVISORY floor check now exists.)
Runs formatter/linter feedback after edits; intentionally never blocks. Spawning it would run real prettier/eslint over the fixture.
Records diagnostic context after a failed tool call; intentionally never blocks.
Persists best-effort context before compaction; intentionally never blocks.
Prints the next ship step after plan mode; intentionally never blocks.

UserPromptSubmit hard block (exit 2) — after an observed implementation edit, requires a successful phase-bound Skill(tdd) result; no-edit prompts and unsupported transcript hosts stand down. Empirical coverage: __tests__/hooks/empirical/skill-forced-eval.test.ts.
Refreshes wiki context after commits. Not fixture-drivable: it diffs HEAD~1..HEAD and would invoke gen-wiki.mjs, writing into wiki/.
Injects .claude/memory-impl.md gotchas when the edited path matches its globs; stdout-inject only, never blocks.
E5 #1947. Advisory by default; ARBITER_SPAWN_GUARD_HARD=1 promotes it. Driven by a Task/Agent dispatch payload on stdin, not a tool-input path.

E5 #1947, #2403. SubagentStop cleanup companion to pre-spawn-worktree-guard.mjs — removes the finished dispatch's agents-active.json sidecar entry so it does not wedge the next spawn for the 2h TTL. Always exits 0. Driven by a SubagentStop payload on stdin, not a tool-input path.
E6b #1948. Advisory by default; ARBITER_FINDING_LOSS_HARD=1 promotes it. Needs a Stop transcript with >=2 agent dispatches, supplied via stdin.

INV-142: validates an edited ontology artifact against its registered schema. NOT spawnable in place: its two registered instances are the live ID registry (docs/internal/SYSTEM/ID-REGISTRY.md — driving the hook means corrupting the SSOT that check-id-registry.mjs and check-ontology-wired.mjs read, on the developer's own tree) and .arbiter/evidence/agent-returns/, where planting a fixture is exactly what INV-139 forbids. Its decision logic is therefore exported pure (selectEntry, extractDocument) and observed by __tests__/hooks/post-edit-artifact-schema.test.ts, which also spawns the hook against a real violation in a scratch clone to assert exit 2.
